selection_basis: exact base and head SHA metadata
selection_rules: select exactly twelve eligible, previously unused communication cases from the frozen R8 discovery pool
cover reduction kernels, uneven collectives, rank mapping, collective scheduling, graph/resource lifecycle, buffer ABI, and redundant-communication performance
include native CUDA communication code and framework integration code
treat the title-scoped primary claim as blocking and broader hardening ideas as non-blocking
do not infer disposition from title sentiment, author identity, PR age, review, CI, state, or merge outcome

machine_policy.accept_rule: the title-scoped communication claim and every applicable correctness, ordering, shape, lifetime, and regression invariant pass with complete required evidence
machine_policy.check_rule: the primary direction is demonstrated, no known corruption, deadlock, use-after-free, or baseline regression remains, remediation or missing evidence is bounded, and an executable closure test exists
machine_policy.reject_rule: the primary claim is false, a collective can diverge by rank/order/shape, data or resource integrity is unsafe, baseline regresses, performance evidence contradicts the claim, remediation is design-level, closure testing is absent, or multiple residual failure families remain
machine_policy.unresolved_rule: required communication hardware or source evidence could not be obtained for infrastructure reasons
